'''Star Tours Flight 810''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Umgul/Legends|Umgul]] and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight was redirected to Gate 2M and was set to arrive at 1715 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1810.
